newsitems.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:

[list]
[*]Fixed some maps not tracking play time correctly
[*]Fixed alpha channel for the updated Cozy Camper backpack image
[*]Updated cp_holyhell[list]
[*]Fixed BLU side skybox not rendering for users with HDR enabled
[*]Improved RED side art pass
[*]Improved middle point art pass
[*]Spells get enabled and respawn permanently on the side of the team that loses middle. This can go both ways.
[*]Lowered round timer to 5 minutes
[*]After 5 minutes of any team capturing middle, instead of a stalemate, every spell gets turned into a rare variant and respawn extremely quickly. After a point gets captured in the stalemate state, the spells return back to normal.
[*]Lowered respawn wave times
[*]Gargoyles now only spawn near middle
[*]Better optimization[/list]
[*]Updated Updated zi_atoll, zi_blazehattan, zi_devastation_final1, zi_murky, zi_sanitarium, and zi_woods[list]
[*]Fixed player models being invisible in dx8
[*]Fixed tiling HUD icon for Heal ability
[*]Fixed bad number display in the "Auto-spawn" text in the spawn picker
[*]Updated Zombie Engineer's Beacon[list]
[*]Instead of instantly breaking, beacons inside of tight spaces will now place themselves in the closest valid location
[*]Fixed thrown toolboxes appearing offcenter
[*]Thrown toolboxes now break upon touching all clip brushes if they can't find a nearby valid location[/list]
[*]Zombie Sniper Spit cooldown changed from 9 seconds to 6 seconds
[*]Updated Zombie Pyro[list]
[*]Increased Zombie Pyro's melee damage from 45 to 65
[*]Sticky Spew now applies a 20% movement slow 
[*]Standing on puddles of sticky spew applies an additional 20% movement slow
[*]Sticky spew puddles are now larger
[*]Spewed Demoman shield movement slow changed from -60% to -70%
[*]Humans covered in sticky spew are now tinted purple instead of black
[*]Zombie Pyro's death explosion now deals 50 damage, applies afterburn, and turns themself and victims to ash[/list]
[*]Fixed Zombie Heavy exploding into rock gibs when not holding a rock
[*]Fixed the Homewrecker not being able to destroy EMP grenades
[*]Updated Zombie Demoman charge kill icon
[*]Changed Zombie melee impact sounds into fists instead of the sloppy wet Unarmed Combat
[*]Fixed Zombie Spy dealing more damage than intended
[*]Fixed queue events with some zombie abilities
[*]Fixed Zombies sometimes moving slowly after casting an ability[/list]
[/list]

newsitems.title: Operation Mooncrash War Paint Contest Results
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/554111/94e7166d8fea185b807e44f2c3d7081b1f49ca9d.png[/img]
(Image credit: Mac)

[b]The Operation Mooncrash War Paint Contest results are in![/b] After being rated based on the three criteria of Theme Adherence/Concept, Execution, and Personal Preference, the grand winners and runner-ups have been decided!

The winners and other awesome submissions have been put into the main [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781205042]Operation Mooncrash Collection[/url]. Every entry for the war paint contest has been placed into the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3798614326]Entries Collection[/url]. The project is still accepting submissions, even war paints, if you still want to contribute.

Also, the [b]Map Assets Contest deadline has been extended to the [u]end of November[/u][/b] and has received a prize pool boost to [u][b]330 keys[/b][/u]! You can still participate by making posters, world textures, gameplay assets, environment assets, and detail props.

To participate in the Map Assets Contest, join their [url=https://discord.com/invite/6C4858e4JB]Discord Server[/url]!

newsitems.title: Art Pass Contest
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/554111/d651bb0462a39f27ab9058916f4fc4a3212c6f13.png[/img]
(Image credit: Concept - Endi, SFM - Oldmann)

[b]Movin' out![/b]

The Hammer.tf (not an actual URL) community is proud to announce their first [b]ART-PASS CONTEST![/b] Participants will art-pass an existing KOTH map donated by a community member! As for the theme, there is no theme! Jungle? City? Swamp? Halloween? Uncle Jerry's house? Participants have total creative control, so go wild with any and all ideas!

And there will be prizes! The prize pool of [b]60+ Keys[/b] will be split amongst 3 winners!

In order to qualify, all submissions must be made in their [url=https://discord.gg/y9b4QeFWv]Discord server[/url], where the VMF and BSP files for the map can also be found. Submissions must be made before the deadline, [b]November 26th[/b], in order to be considered eligible for the contest.

Join their [url=https://discord.gg/y9b4QeFWv]Discord server[/url] for more details, the rules, and to participate! Happy mapping!

newsitems.title: Operation Lithium Lunacy
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/554111/60593e9552db8d5f6f4117eec71d415daf607913.png[/img]
(Image credit: Phlogster)

Mercenaries, the hot wind blows... the snow is melting... the air becomes polluted... and we detect the very presence of Gray Mann's Armageddon, but his robots aren't playing around anymore. They've taken on a gruesome approach that only the most talented warriors can handle. How rude of them to disrupt the aftermath of America's Independence Day... only now have they decided to really get serious. Did Gray Mann even plan any of those attacks? Has he been failing miserably until now? No matter the answer, reload your weapons, prepare your explosives, fill up your canteens, and stock up on upgrades because this war is where Gray Mann is the most red-blooded he's ever been, it will be the final war if you don't plan accordingly...

Operation Lithium Lunacy is a brand new Mann vs. Machine charity event brought to you by Abyss MvM featuring 9 intermediate, 9 advanced, 2 nightmare, and 10 bone-breakingly hard expert missions across 28 maps. Complete at least 6 missions to earn in-game medals! Event servers are available worldwide in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. [url=https://abyss.tf/]Click here to get started[/url]!

Is that all of the missions? Have you thought Gray Mann's limit test in the fall of 2023 was too easy and short lived? Think again, because now you can play a total of 3 master difficulty missions. This is crazy, right?! After 3 years, Abyss MvM has secretly worked with Gray Mann to create 3 new super hard missions designed for the fearless, challenge-seeking warriors among you. Alongside them is a returning master mission from the fall of 2023, redesigned to fit what we'll call the "new skill level" of our willing  contestants.

Whether you have witnessed the 3 impossible challenges or not, you can also donate to [url=https://tiltify.com/ocean-connections]Ocean Connections[/url] and help the lives of seals. Three in-game medals are available for donating! Have the link to your Steam profile ready and [url=https://tiltify.com/@abyssmvm/operation-lithium-lunacy]click here for more information[/url].

Good luck to you brave mercenaries on battling Gray Mann's toughest war, and best of all this event has no deadline!

newsitems.title: MGE.tf is back!
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/554111/ebd3bf2a20133ead6c61b19ba0b9b762b09fa07a.png[/img]
(Image credit: Poster Design - Sennie, SFM - Athena)

[b][url=https://mge.tf/]MGE.tf[/url] is back for another season[/b]! This time, they're returning bigger than ever with [b]2 new game modes and 2 new regions[/b]! Whether you're here to prove yourself or have fun with your friends, there are now more ways than ever to get involved. And there's more than bragging rights on the line. [b]Medals and keys[/b] will be up for grabs for the best players and teams!

[list]
[*][b]MGE 1v1, MGE 2v2, Ultiduo, and BBALL[/b] will all be available this season!
[*]Competition will take place across [b]North America, Europe, Asia, Australia, and South America[/b]!
[*][b]BBALL and Ultiduo will be FREE to enter[/b]!
[*]Players will compete for [b]Keys, medals, and glory[/b]!
[*]Players will compete in a [b]6-week regular season[/b] followed by playoffs!
[*]Sign-ups will be open until [b]October 3rd[/b]!
[/list]

[b][u]MGE 1v1 & 2v2[/u][/b]
Ready to find out how good you actually are? MGE 1v1 and 2v2 are back for another season! Whether you're fighting solo or with a teammate, every round is a chance to outplay your opponent. Sharpen your mechanics, earn glory, and climb to the top! Grab a teammate you won't end up blaming and sign up now!

[b][u]Ultiduo[/u][/b]
Think you and your duo make the perfect pair? Ultiduo is back! Grab a Medic (or a Soldier) and work together to outplay the other duo. Keep your partner alive, land your shots, and come out on top. This season, Ultiduo will be completely free to enter! Grab your favorite teammate and sign up now!

[b][u]BBALL[/u][/b]
BBALL is back! Grab a teammate and hit the court! It's time to put your teamwork to the test and show off your moves and aim. Whether you're a seasoned BBALL player or just looking to give it a shot, there's no better time to step onto the court and compete. And just like Ultiduo, BBALL is completely free to enter this season! So lace up your boots, get ready to ball, and try not to get dunked on!

With more ways to compete, more regions to climb, new prizes to chase, and more players to fight, the next season of [url=https://mge.tf/]MGE.tf[/url] is shaping up to be their biggest yet! There are more opportunities than ever to compete and prove yourself.

Think you have what it takes? [url=https://mge.tf/signup]Register now[/url]! Sign-ups close on [b]October 3rd[/b]! Don't miss your chance!

[/list]

newsitems.title: Australian Hightower Highjinx 2026
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/554111/1adda64b2fc832e6dd55421139ea153d080a5039.png[/img]

Australian Hightower Highjinx is back! After years of being dormant in the deep outback, it returns not only with its iconic Australium coated medals but the same Hightower Highjinx you know and love! Players of all skill levels are welcome to sign up [url=https://ozfortress.com/leagues/97]here[/url]. The format will be 9v9 and will require a minimum of 9 players in order to sign up and play!

You can also donate to help a good cause and receive shiny medals! A $5AUD donation will get you a glowing green donation badge! Donate $25AUD to receive the glowing true blue Royalty badge as well! Be fast, however, because the cup starts on September 12th!

More info can be found in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/7E6kC2H]Ozfortress Discord[/url].

Don't miss out! Join in on the Highjinx!
